description: Answers what a specific OpenRouter top-up or other AI service invoice charges, whether it can still be paid through Rozo Checkout, and which coins can pay it. Takes the payment link URL and returns the merchant, invoice amount, callerPays (the USD amount the invoice charges), the link expiry, payability and supportedSources: the coins THIS invoice can be paid with. The exact amount to send in a given coin, including the service fee, bridge and network fees, or the FX spread on a native coin, comes from create_deposit_order. Offer a native coin (ETH, BNB, POL, SOL) only when it appears in supportedSources. Creates nothing and moves no funds.
name: quote_invoice
title: Quote an AI service invoice
